summary:
The three repaired problems (T1, T2, T3) are all gone, and the repair broke nothing. Nothing I found blocks shipping. Only tools/smoke.js changed in this round. js/app.js, js/salon.js and tools/test-salon.js are byte-identical to what the first checker tested: app.js has md5 3c6f2856… and was last changed at 13:47, before the first check started at 15:22. So the game behaves exactly as already verified.

For each problem I first rebuilt the test file as it was before the repair, in a scratch copy (the repair's new checks removed; the X steps as they were at 6d03faf, plus the first fix's step rebuilt). I reproduced the old problem there, then showed it gone on the repaired file.

- **T1 (should): an undone gift slot was not guarded.**
  - Before the repair: mutant MD (`>= 1` changed to `>= 0` in GONE.gift) passes Q section 23 with 38/0.
  - After the repair: MD fails the new check 23-1b ('안 한 «선물 상자» 칸 (n 0) 은 세지 않는다: (5/5) · 받기 단추 true · 점 true …') with 39/1.
  - I also built real production saves: a real f2c93f1 tab wrote a week with the gift slot not done, then the fixed build opened it at 320x568.
    - Same week: (4/5), no claim button, no dot, no keptIds, no kept line.
    - Next Monday: no week.prev, only that day's gift (shells 23 to 26).
    - Same with a 'days' slot that also counts: four done, no payout.
    - A gift really offered in production (gift slot n 1), opened first on Monday: pays 12 shells and 2 seeds once, with the '지난주' toast once.
- **T3 (nit): two parts of item 2 had no failing check.**
  - Before the repair: mutants MB (weekDoneN reads the kept number) and MC (no dedupe) each pass 38/0.
  - After the repair: each fails the new check 23-1c with 39/1.
- **T2 (nit): the late-write checks in X.**
  - Before the repair: under mutant MF0 (IMPORT_HOLD = 0), X gives 50/1. Only the old im3 check fails. The new step's stale record is `typeof window.__xpre === 'undefined'`, so that step passed whatever the guard did. With no mutant, a 1.5 s busy-wait between the two calls makes the old im3 check fail (50/1). That is the speed dependence the first checker described.
  - After the repair: MF0 fails both im2 and g1 (49/2). My own mutant MG (drop every write inside the window, whatever its lastSeen) fails 4 checks.
  - With 1.5 s busy-waits added after the import in im2 and g1, and at the start of im3, X passes 51/0. So the checks no longer depend on machine speed.
- **N1:** the repair deliberately left it. It is unchanged and was not made by this change.

Suites on a /dev/shm copy whose files were byte-identical to the tree. Load average was 2.7 to 4.0 on 4 CPUs, with another lane running browsers.
- Q section 23 alone: 40/0 three times in a row.
- Full SMOKE_ONLY=Q: 73/0.
- SMOKE_ONLY=X: 51/0 twice.
- npm test: exit 0.
- Font check: stale none.

No player-facing text changed in this round, so the hard lines are unaffected. I found only two small new gaps (nits below). Neither is a defect in the game.

problems.title: No check opens an unrepaired production gift slot directly at the week change
problems.where: js/app.js:4400 (`due` uses keptWith(w) -> oldDone -> GONE.gift); tools/smoke.js Q 23-1 / 23-1b (5288-5319)
problems.what: 23-1 (gift n 1) and 23-1b (gift n 0) both open the week on Sunday first. That runs the same-week repair, which stores keptIds. On Monday the payout then reads keptIds, not the gift slot. So the week-change path (`due` evaluating a gift slot still in the list) never runs in any check. This is the common case of a player who last played on production and next opens the game on a Monday. The predicate GONE.gift is shared with the same-week path, so MD is still caught. Only a change that treats gift differently at the week change would slip through.
problems.evidence: grep finds no gift seed opened at MON. My real production probes cover it by play: an n 0 gift slot opened first on 11-16 gives no week.prev and 23 to 26 shells; an offered gift (n 1) opened first on 11-16 pays 12/2 once, from 2026-11-09, shells 23 to 38. Logs: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/recheck-v2/runs/01-probe-p-clean.log and 03-probe-p-clean.log; probe script recheck-v2/p1n.js.
problems.suggested_fix: Optional. In 23-1b, add a second context seeded with the same week and opened directly on MON. Expect no prev and shells 23. Do the same for 23-1's n 1 week, expecting a payout of 12/2 once.

problems.title: keptOf's filter for unknown ids has no failing check
problems.what: If that filter is removed, unknown ids in keptIds count as removed tasks. No check fails. Only a hand-edited or damaged save can hold such ids. The current code is correct (the first checker's seeded case e collapses duplicate and unknown ids to 2).
problems.evidence: My mutant MJ (keptOf returns `a.indexOf(id) === i` only) passes Q section 23 with 40/0: recheck-v2/runs/06-q23-new-MJ.log.
problems.suggested_fix: Optional. In 23-1c, seed keptIds ['days','days','x'] instead of ['days','days'] and keep the (4/5) expectation.

problems.title: Still present, not from this change: the new tab's repair resets a re-dealt slot's rerolls
problems.what: Unchanged since the first check (app.js is byte-identical). Points are counted once, so a player gains nothing. The repair left it on purpose: keeping rr would cut the rerolls of production slots in the new build, which is a visible behaviour change. I agree it can wait.
problems.evidence: md5 of js/app.js is identical to the first-checked version. First checker's log: check-v2/p2-fix.log.

mutations:
Each mutant was applied alone to a /dev/shm copy of the tree. The Q runs used a temporary hook, placed after the line that defines FIVE, that runs only qGone; it was never in the real tree. App mutants:
- MD: GONE.gift `>= 1` changed to `>= 0`. Pre-repair Q23 38/0 (survives); repaired 39/1 (23-1b).
- MB: weekDoneN reads `(w.kept | 0)`. Pre 38/0; repaired 39/1 (23-1c).
- MC: keptOf without dedupe. Pre 38/0; repaired 39/1 (23-1c).
- MJ (mine): keptOf without the GONE-membership filter. Repaired 40/0, so it survives (finding R2).
- MF0: IMPORT_HOLD = 0. Pre X 50/1 (old im3 only); repaired X 49/2 (im2 and g1).
- MG (mine): the storage guard drops every write inside the window, whatever its lastSeen. Repaired X 47/4: im2, two future-lastSeen import checks, and g1.

Test-file variants:
- OLDSLOW: pre-repair file, 1.5 s busy-wait at the start of im3, no app mutant. 50/1: old im3 fails, confirming the old speed dependence.
- NEWSLOW: repaired file, 1.5 s busy-waits after the import in im2 and g1 and at the start of im3. 51/0.
